canonical_statement: The universe is composed of four fundamental elements: water, earth, air, and ether.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Yot’ang’d’ang, water, earth, air and ether.

canonical_statement: The spiritual hierarchy of existence consists of the earth, the lower heaven, and the upper heaven.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Ka’fom’ji, earth, lower heaven and upper heaven.

canonical_statement: A spiritual entity representing wisdom and gentleness acts as a mediator for the Great Spirit and oversees the redemption of the earth through love.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The earth is Mine, saith Sed; by love will I redeem it.

canonical_statement: Guardian angels operate on a rotational schedule synchronized with the lunar phases, necessitating specific days of rest for mortals.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Let my chosen keep the four holy days of rest during each moon, for on these days do my guardian angels change the watch.

canonical_statement: The ultimate creative principle is the source of all existence, encompassing both life and death, and maintaining the universe through its continuous will.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: I am the Light, the Life and the Death. Out of myself made I all.

canonical_statement: The Earth is a manifestation of a feminine spiritual principle, which serves as the mother of all humanity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The earth was Mi, and Mi was the earth.

canonical_statement: The universe is structured into hierarchical states of density, ranging from the rarified ether to the dense corporeal worlds.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Ether, the most rarified place; Ji’ay, the second place; A’ji, the third; and fourth, corpor.

canonical_statement: Atmospheric or ethereal conditions in the firmament directly influence the physical and behavioral states of corporeal life on Earth.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: When the earth passeth through A’ji, it aggregateth and groweth.

canonical_statement: The perception of past lives is a sensory illusion induced by specific spiritual influences during certain ethereal cycles.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Evil spirits in the time of Jy’ay shall train the corporeal senses to believe they lived before.

canonical_statement: Time is structured into cyclical periods of approximately three thousand years.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: A cycle of time is about three thousand years.

canonical_statement: The divine entity (E-O-Ih) possesses an auditory capacity that perceives all human communications.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Let the Che be above the altar as a sign that the E-O-Ih heareth.

canonical_statement: The universe is organized into specific directional quadrants that hold symbolic and metaphysical significance.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The master of the lodge shall sit in Denem, i.e., the east.

canonical_statement: Human physical organs and gestures serve as symbolic representations of higher spiritual or cosmic functions.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The palm dealeth in mystery. He pointeth, and by his hand’s course shall he be read.

canonical_statement: Time is a measurable, finite quantity within the structure of the universe.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Equal to four million seven hundred thousand years.

canonical_statement: Spiritual receptivity is a prerequisite for the acquisition of divine truth.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Save your spirits become as cows ye can not be impregnated with new things.

canonical_statement: Self-assertion and unprovable spirit teachings are mechanisms of spiritual enslavement.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Many of the people were converted by Sa’tau, and their souls thus enslaved.

canonical_statement: Fire serves as an emblem for the dissolution of corporeal matter and the liberation of the soul.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Emblem of corporeal dissolution and of the escape of the potent power within.

canonical_statement: Ritual sacrifice and repentance function as mechanisms for the purification of the soul.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: In thy obedience to Agni is my great sin burnt up.

canonical_statement: The belief in a singular, anthropomorphic 'Lord' or 'God' of the earth is a form of idolatry that obscures the Great Spirit.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: They have made an idol of the wind and called it Lord.

canonical_statement: The worship of an exclusive, singular savior figure is a form of idolatry that fosters conflict and war.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: They profess to feast his nostrils with the smell of burning flesh... are they not all idolatrous warriors?

canonical_statement: Spiritual authority that relies on force, exclusive salvation, or the sword is categorized as a lower-heaven manifestation.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Any spirit who commands or rules by force; any exclusive Savior of men.

canonical_statement: Prophetic insight is a state of 'soul-seeing' attained through the discipline of sacrifice and the cultivation of inner light.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: A man of light. Clear sight... one who by much sacrifice hath attained to soul-seeing.

canonical_statement: The universe operates under a law of reciprocity where those who propagate violence and exclusive rule are destined to perish by those same means.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Whoever professeth the sword and the spear... shall perish thereby.

canonical_statement: The physical universe and its movements are encoded in sacred symbolic systems that reflect divine order.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The high priest shall designate by the Um, the motion of the sun and moon.

canonical_statement: Human identity and gender are represented through specific symbolic profiles and portraits in sacred language.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Profile, man or mankind. Portrait, man only, and not woman.

canonical_statement: The structure of reality is governed by vortexian motion which can be tracked and interpreted through sacred signs.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: V.Work-’um. Course of vortex.

canonical_statement: The corporeal body serves as a gestation vessel for the spirit.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: I give him a corporeal body, which is a womb for the spirit

canonical_statement: Spiritual progression is achieved through self-perfecting wisdom and goodness, not through external salvation.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Save ye have learned to perfect your own selves in wisdom and goodness ye shall not rise

canonical_statement: The universe is structured into hierarchical realms, with atmospherea serving as a transitional state between the corporeal world and the higher etherea.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: boundary of the lower heavens or atmospherea, and the inner boundary of the emancipated heavens

canonical_statement: Spiritual advancement is a gradual process of growth rather than an instantaneous transition.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: If a child can not reach manhood but by growth, how hope ye to reach Chinvat suddenly

canonical_statement: Human consciousness and identity evolve through distinct developmental stages, beginning from an aboriginal, pre-linguistic state.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: A’SU. A man in aboriginal state; before he used words; before he congregated.

canonical_statement: Humanity is not inherently evil but exists in a state of developmental immaturity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Call not any man evil; but call ye him unripe fruit.

canonical_statement: The Divine is a singular entity possessing two fundamental, complementary attributes: the positive (projective) and the negative (receptive).

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The ALL ONE is but ONE, but with two attributes.

canonical_statement: Individual human consciousness is structured by the internal interplay of positive and negative attributes, allowing for self-reflection.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Two attributes gave I... to every man-self... that he might hold discourse within himself.

canonical_statement: Spiritual receptivity and the perception of the Divine require the cultivation of the receptive (negative) attribute.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Until a man have OM in the ascendent he shall not hear nor see the Great Spirit.

canonical_statement: Etherean entities intervene in human history during cycles of darkness to provide guidance and deliverance.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: I provided for the nations in their darkness... I send My etherean angels to deliver them.

canonical_statement: The Divine maintains ownership of all earthly territories, rendering nationalistic claims to land illusory.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: All countries are Jehovih’s.

canonical_statement: Post-mortem progression is determined by the specific metaphysical belief system held by the individual during life.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: They all rise to the destiny they have chosen.

canonical_statement: Materialism causes the spirit to remain tethered to the physical plane after death.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Save a man put away the Pan that is in him, he can not rise.

canonical_statement: Human incarnation originated from angels choosing to consume the fruit of the Tree of Life, resulting in earthly bondage.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Angels... did eat of the fruit of the Tree of Life, and they were tempted.

canonical_statement: The corporeal body and the spirit body are intrinsically linked; actions affecting one necessarily affect the other.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Whatever ye do unto one for its good, rendereth good to the other.

canonical_statement: Love is the fundamental causal force behind all movement and creation in the universe.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: By love only moveth any man; even in anger he moveth not but by love.

canonical_statement: The ultimate Creator is formless and incomprehensible, distinct from entities that possess form or figure.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Whoever saith the Incomprehensible is God, blasphemeth before Him.

canonical_statement: Entities inhabiting the lower heavens (atmospherea) often masquerade as the supreme Creator to establish dominion over mortals.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Have not many of the tyrants of I’em returned to earth and proclaimed themselves Lord?

canonical_statement: The lower heavens are structurally adjacent to the physical earth and are organized into kingdoms ruled by entities known as Gods.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The lower heavens are next to the earth, and are full of kingdoms.

canonical_statement: Worship of anthropomorphic or finite figures limits spiritual perception and subjects the worshiper to the dominion of those entities.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Whosoever saith, Before thee, O God, I bow my head, selleth himself to Osiris.

canonical_statement: Human social cohesion is facilitated by shared virtues and mutual love, forming distinct communities.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: They who love one another, having some virtues alike, shall become a people unto themselves.

canonical_statement: The belief that humanity is the highest form of existence and the sole source of authority is a spiritual error.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: One who believes man is the highest of all things in the world.

canonical_statement: Indulgence in physical desires without spiritual recognition leads to susceptibility to parasitic spirits.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: They became the prey of spirits of idleness and lust.

canonical_statement: Material representations or symbols are distinct from the reality they signify.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: As a picture of a foot is not a foot.

canonical_statement: The misidentification of the Creator as a human-like entity on a throne is a fundamental spiritual ignorance.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: He is believed by people in darkness to be the Creator.

canonical_statement: The universe is composed of three fundamental entities: the Creator, the corporeal realm, and the spiritual realm.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Jehovih one, Corpor two, Es three, or third entity; the unseen, the air and ether.

canonical_statement: The spiritual realm (Es) is an unseen dimension that permeates the air and ether.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Es three... the unseen, the air and ether.

canonical_statement: The corporeal world functions as a womb for the development of consciousness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: All the corporeal world is a womb

canonical_statement: The fundamental state of the material world is one of universal conflict.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: all things are against all things

canonical_statement: Spirit and love are the underlying substances of all reality.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: spirit and love underlie all

canonical_statement: Divine light persists even within the state of darkness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: even in darkness, the light of the Father shines

canonical_statement: Growth and manifestation originate from darkness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: all growth cometh out of darkness

canonical_statement: Evil is a spiritual entity distinct from the death of mortal things.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: As Ra, death, is to mortal things, so is Ra’o to spiritual.

canonical_statement: The physical world and all things within it are products of divine organization of light and darkness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: the light and darkness were created, and all things on the earth became organized.

canonical_statement: Conceit is a hidden internal enemy that obstructs the perception of truth.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Ay’in, conceit, the hidden enemy in one’s own heart; they would not hear.

canonical_statement: Human identity is fundamentally linked to the status of a 'Son of Light'.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: PUPIL: A Son of Light.

canonical_statement: The ultimate object of worship and faith is the singular, omnipresent Creator.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: I pray to none but the Ever Present Creator.

canonical_statement: Spiritual merit is derived from performing good works for the benefit of all humanity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: trusting only in good works done unto all men.

canonical_statement: The human soul is subject to post-mortem punishment or suffering based on spiritual alignment.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: thy soul shall feed the fires of hell.

canonical_statement: Spirits of the deceased can be summoned and made to manifest through occult practices.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: called up the spirits of the dead, who did appear before them.

canonical_statement: The physical structure of the human brain and nervous system can be permanently altered during infancy to determine the character of the adult.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: brain and nerves of flesh could be changed in infancy by pressure to make the grown-up man of any character desired

canonical_statement: Specific repetitive auditory stimuli can induce altered states of consciousness known as the prophetic spell.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: the monotony of sound that brings on the prophetic spell

canonical_statement: The pursuit of worldly power, military might, and idolatry leads inevitably to the ruin and desolation of civilizations.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: pride and glory lay in ships of war... now ruined and desolate

canonical_statement: The performance of mundane, practical labor constitutes the highest form of service to the Creator.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: A useful employment is the highest service to the Maker of all.

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of spiritual worship involves a cessation of earthly concerns and a repose in spirit.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: recipients repose in spirit from all the cares of the earth.

canonical_statement: The individual's strength and spiritual orientation are derived from total alignment with the Divine.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Now am I strong in Thee, O Jehovih.

canonical_statement: Spiritual blindness or the refusal to look upward toward the Divine leads to the experience of earthly suffering.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: a serpent cometh upon him and he crieth out against the vanities of the earth.

canonical_statement: Human orientation toward either transient material objects or eternal divine principles determines spiritual destiny.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The heart of the man of darkness is downward to things that perish.

canonical_statement: The physical universe functions as a divine text or record that reveals the nature of the Creator.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: All things proclaim the words Thou hast written.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness is quickened and enabled to perceive divine reality through direct interaction with the Creator.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Thine hand hath quickened my eyes to see and mine ears to hear Thee.

canonical_statement: There exists a cosmic judge who oversees the transition and status of both the living and the dead.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Eon shall judge the living and the dead.

canonical_statement: Human suffering and trials serve as instruments for the refinement and expansion of individual wisdom.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: My trials shall be as whet-stones and a hewing-ax.

canonical_statement: The corporeal world is situated at the lowest level of existence.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The corporeal world hast Thou placed in the midst of the lowest places.

canonical_statement: The Creator exists as an omnipresent, non-corporeal source that precedes and transcends all physical manifestations.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Jehovih, Who createth without things that are made, the All First Creator.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is capable of detaching from corporeal attachments to ascend toward a higher, non-physical state.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Make me oblivious to all corporeal things, and fill me with Thy going-forth.

canonical_statement: The soul originates from and returns to an unseen, divine source, analogous to the ephemeral nature of perfume.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Is my spirit like perfume? Whence cometh it, and whither goeth it?

canonical_statement: The human soul is inherently distinct from the corporeal body and ascends to a higher state upon death.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: freed from the earth his inner part, the soul, ascendeth

canonical_statement: Reincarnation is a factual process where souls return to the earth in new corporeal forms.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: I have witnessed the souls of men returned to the earth, reclothed in corporeal substance

canonical_statement: The spirit possesses inherent power over the corporeal world, allowing for the manifestation of miracles.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: taught the power of the spirit over the corporeal part

canonical_statement: The corporeal world is under the perpetual guardianship of a divine spiritual entity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: He was made... to take charge of this corporeal world, which is His

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is constantly surrounded by non-corporeal entities, even when physical perception is obscured.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: thou art surrounded by Gods and Lords of heaven and earth

canonical_statement: Human beings must undergo trials of their spiritual integrity either in the physical realm or the afterlife to achieve resurrection.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: all men must be tried, either in the corporeal world or in the next

canonical_statement: The human soul is immortal and survives the death of the physical body.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: my soul shall never die

canonical_statement: Faith is the fundamental creative force utilized by the Creator to manifest the universe.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: By faith the All Creator created.

canonical_statement: The physical body can be rendered invulnerable to harm through the exercise of spiritual power and faith.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: he hath power over fire and will not burn

canonical_statement: Physical matter can be manifested or transformed from nothingness through the application of spiritual will.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: As Gau from nothing sprang... come thou, the fibre of corporeal parts

canonical_statement: Procreation creates a spiritual tether that binds the parent to the offspring after death.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: he who begetteth a child is bound in spirit, after death, unto his own offspring.

canonical_statement: The afterlife is divided into two distinct realms: one connected to the corporeal earth and one situated in the higher firmament.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Two heavens there are: one resteth on the corporeal earth; one standeth high in the firmament.

canonical_statement: Transition between spiritual realms requires purification from corporeal attachments and thoughts.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: must they return to the lower heaven till purged of all corporeal thoughts.

canonical_statement: Access to metaphysical knowledge is contingent upon the moral and intellectual purity of the seeker.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Only to the wise, the pure, and the just, do I reveal the mysteries.

canonical_statement: The corporeal world is a manifestation of divine design.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: the rose and the lily, adorned by the Hand of Elohim.

canonical_statement: The physical universe is governed and maintained by divine entities who oversee mortal needs.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The moon, who changeth her size... according to the nightwatch of the Ghads.

canonical_statement: The structure of reality is defined by a duality of light and darkness, representing opposing spiritual forces.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: One side of the world is all light and one side all black.

canonical_statement: New corporeal worlds are created and supervised by divine beings appointed by the supreme creator.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: A new corporeal world... sprung from the surface thereof, hang the sacred signs of holy Lords.

canonical_statement: Spirits of the deceased are called to participate in the development and education of new worlds.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The trumpet calleth... to the spirits of mortals now dead... to the new world above.

canonical_statement: Individual power is amplified through collective unity and adherence to ancient spiritual rites.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: That I may unite myself with other men, and thus become a greater power.

canonical_statement: Physical cranial modification can facilitate the development of prophetic perception.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: my head was thus compressed, to school the judgment down beneath the prophetic sight.

canonical_statement: The non-physical realm (Es) is accessible to human consciousness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: I have seen the Es world and the angels of the dead.

canonical_statement: The universe is permeated by the presence of the divine (Egoquim).

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: the cup, that all the firmament is filled by the presence of Egoquim.

canonical_statement: Non-violence toward living creatures is a prerequisite for spiritual alignment.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: my ancestors killed not any living creature Egoquim had created.

canonical_statement: Human identity is dualistic, composed of both animalistic and spiritual natures.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: That man at best is two beings, a beast and a spirit.

canonical_statement: Actions taken in the physical realm, specifically violence, create lingering spiritual consequences in the afterlife.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The mortal who slayeth the wolf and serpent hath a hard time in heaven.

canonical_statement: The afterlife environment is subject to the influence of the deceased's past actions, including the presence of those they harmed.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: In the firmament of heaven he is haunted; the spirits of the slain come upon him.

canonical_statement: Human existence is tasked with the mastery of the physical world and the refinement of internal speech.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: That all the earth must be subdued by man.

canonical_statement: The soul is an indestructible entity that persists beyond physical death.

attributions.surface_quote: I provide My heavenly places... so that the soul of man can never reach to the boundary thereof.

canonical_statement: The universe is composed of infinite, expanding realms of consciousness created by the Divine.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: I answer you with millions of new creations! Farther than the farthest, boundless!

canonical_statement: Post-mortem progression is a process of moving upward into increasingly delightful and permanent states of being.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: I take them not backward to toil and sorrow; but upward, onward, to heavens of delight.

canonical_statement: All souls are destined to return to the Divine source regardless of their temporary straying.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Though they stray away for a season, yet have I provided them to return to Me in the end.

canonical_statement: The afterlife experience is calibrated to the individual's level of spiritual understanding.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: I will render unto him the delights of My kingdoms according to the light of his understanding.

canonical_statement: The souls of the deceased maintain a connection to the living, acting as a supportive influence.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: As a cord that lifteth a weight, so shall be the soul of the dead to those that are stricken.

canonical_statement: Death functions as the mechanism for the resurrection of the soul.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: By death provide I the resurrection of the souls of the dead.

canonical_statement: The ultimate evolutionary trajectory of the human soul is to attain the status of a God in the heavens.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The time shall come when this living soul shall be as a God.

canonical_statement: The individual soul possesses inherent ownership of the entirety of the physical and spiritual universe.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: To thee I give the earth and the heavens, to be thine forever.

canonical_statement: Self-ownership is a unique divine gift bestowed exclusively upon human beings.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: I give thyself to thee.

canonical_statement: Knowledge derived from the soul is divine and infallible, whereas knowledge derived solely from corporeal senses leads to spiritual darkness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Learn thou corporeal knowledge through thy soul... follow thy corporeal senses only, and thou shalt go down in darkness.

canonical_statement: The fundamental purpose of the universe is the eternal resurrection and progression of the human soul.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: The plan of My creations is for the resurrection of the soul of man.

canonical_statement: Guardian spirits influence the human soul directly, bypassing the corporeal senses.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Nor shall ye ever make yourselves known to him through his corporeal senses; for your labor is with the spirit.

canonical_statement: The individual soul is designed for a process of perpetual resurrection and evolution.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: For perpetual resurrection shapedst mine every part

canonical_statement: The Creator exists as an imperishable, singular, and omnipotent substrate underlying all existence.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Thou One Alone, imperishable forever, and just and merciful.

canonical_statement: The unseen heavens are objective realities created by the Divine.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: To reveal the unseen heavens created by Thee!

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is capable of accessing divine wisdom through prophetic revelation.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 RULES IN COLLEGE OF PROPHECY (PRIMARY).
attributions.surface_quote: Thou hast provided prophets to know the way of the Omnipotent!

canonical_statement: The universe is structured into hierarchical realms, with lower heavens (atmospherea) serving as a transitional state for souls before they reach higher, emancipated realms (etherea).

attributions.surface_quote: all souls must pass... ere they can inherit the emancipated worlds in etherea.

canonical_statement: The afterlife is not a chaotic void but a highly organized system governed by divine administrators and instructional hierarchies.

attributions.surface_quote: many such angels believe the heavens to be as an unorganized wilderness

canonical_statement: The consciousness and beliefs of disembodied spirits directly influence the mental states and perceptions of living mortals.

attributions.surface_quote: by virtue of their presence with mortals... do inspire mortals with the same darkness.

canonical_statement: The lower heavens are physically tethered to the earth and move in synchronization with it through space.

attributions.surface_quote: atmospherea, which heavens travel with the earth around the sun

canonical_statement: The ultimate nature of reality and the structure of the universe are destined to be fully revealed to all sentient beings.

attributions.surface_quote: The time shall surely come when all things shall be revealed.

canonical_statement: The process of spiritual evolution and resurrection is an eternal progression.

attributions.surface_quote: my words are for your resurrection forever

canonical_statement: The universe is composed of a multitude of distinct spiritual kingdoms accessible to consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: The multitude of my kingdoms shall be opened up to your understanding

attributions.surface_quote: The universe is structured into hierarchical heavenly plateaux and kingdoms governed by divine entities.

attributions.surface_quote: The afterlife consists of atmospheric regions and plateaux containing numerous sub-kingdoms.

canonical_statement: Divine authority and governance are organized through successional lines of Gods, generals, and captains within heavenly regions.

attributions.surface_quote: Divine authority is organized through successional lines of Gods, generals, and captains.

canonical_statement: The universe is structured into hierarchical atmospheric regions and heavenly kingdoms inhabited by divine entities.

attributions.surface_quote: six plateaux of Vraggaomen, with their fourteen hundred heavenly kingdoms

canonical_statement: The intermediate spiritual realm is populated by beings who have transitioned from mortal existence.

attributions.surface_quote: intermediate world of the angels raised up out of the earth

canonical_statement: Divine authority manifests through the collective alignment of heavenly beings into a singular unified consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: They shall come together and be as one man with one voice

canonical_statement: Higher metaphysical knowledge is transmitted from divine sources to the mortal plane through linguistic mediation.

attributions.surface_quote: The labors of My lower heavens shall be clothed in mortal words

canonical_statement: The ultimate source of existence is an infallible, singular fountainhead that transcends all individual deities and celestial beings.

attributions.surface_quote: My words are from the Fountain, that erreth not forever.

canonical_statement: The divine essence is the collective sum of all lower celestial expressions and historical cycles.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the sum of the Voice of all the lower heavens.

canonical_statement: Divine revelation functions as a cyclical, enduring link within the solar vortex, facilitating the resurrection of spirits.

attributions.surface_quote: I am as a link in a great circle, the section of Bon.

canonical_statement: The fundamental truth of reality is found in the unified essence derived from the totality of existence, rather than individual histories.

attributions.surface_quote: the pith of things is the unit sprung from all.

canonical_statement: The intermediate spiritual realm (Hada) requires purification of the self as a prerequisite for ascension to higher ethereal states.

attributions.surface_quote: None can pass to the etherean heaven till purged of self.

canonical_statement: All conscious beings are subject to a binary trajectory of either resurrection toward the Divine or declension away from it.

attributions.surface_quote: To one or other, resurrection or declension, belong all men.

canonical_statement: Stasis is impossible; all living entities are in a state of perpetual motion.

attributions.surface_quote: None can stand still; all the living are on the move forever.

canonical_statement: The fundamental attributes of existence—life, motion, individuality, and personhood—are derived directly from the Divine and cannot be transferred or created by subordinate entities.

attributions.surface_quote: None of the Gods, however exalted, give to or take away these things.

canonical_statement: Resurrection is defined as the active development of the four inherent divine entities: life, motion, individuality, and personhood.

attributions.surface_quote: To develop these four entities is resurrection toward Him.

canonical_statement: Individual human consciousness is infinitesimal in scale compared to the collective consciousness of celestial beings.

attributions.surface_quote: thou art compared to them but as a drop of water is compared to the ocean.

canonical_statement: Divine communication is mediated through collective angelic entities rather than individual human conscience.

attributions.surface_quote: My angels speak to you in spirit, with my very voice and words.

canonical_statement: Human talent and vocational focus determine the specific nature of the angelic influence assigned to the individual.

attributions.surface_quote: to the musician, angel musicians; to the philosopher, angel philosophers.

canonical_statement: Angelic entities operate as highly organized, unified hierarchies rather than autonomous individuals.

attributions.surface_quote: these my ashars... are organized companies of thousands of millions.

canonical_statement: The structure of the universe is a nested hierarchy of consciousness, where lower entities are unified with higher divine councils.

attributions.surface_quote: all of them are in concord with me and my kingdoms, directed by my Holy Council.

canonical_statement: The structure of the heavenly hierarchy is organized into delegated administrative tiers to facilitate communication with the supreme authority.

attributions.surface_quote: God allotted to every one of them one hundred messengers and fifty heralds.

canonical_statement: Heavenly administrative structures are designed to mirror or symbolize the cyclical patterns of the physical earth.

attributions.surface_quote: The representative Lords shall be known... as the Holy Eleven, for they are symbolical of the seasons.

canonical_statement: The history and administrative appointments of the heavenly realms are recorded in permanent celestial archives.

attributions.surface_quote: Their names were entered in the libraries of the heavens.

canonical_statement: The afterlife is structured into hierarchical spatial spheres based on the spiritual maturity of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: As they rise in wisdom and strength, they shall advance in place as well as grade.

canonical_statement: Attachment to mortal kin acts as a tether that impedes the soul's necessary progression toward higher spiritual realms.

attributions.surface_quote: The great love that mortals have for their kindred who are dead, is like a chord forever pulling their souls back to earth.

canonical_statement: The resurrection of the soul requires a detachment from earthly concerns and mortal relationships.

attributions.surface_quote: They do not understand that their prayers are in opposition to the resurrection of spirits of the dead.

canonical_statement: The spiritual universe is organized into administrative divisions managed by hierarchical entities.

attributions.surface_quote: God appointed two thousand supervisors unto each of the Holy Eleven.

canonical_statement: Communication between the living and the deceased is prohibited by divine mandate.

attributions.surface_quote: Suffer ye not mortals to commune with the spirits of the dead.

canonical_statement: Divine authority is executed by intermediary entities or hierarchies.

attributions.surface_quote: And the Lords carried out the commandment of God.

canonical_statement: The afterlife is structured into a hierarchical system of spheres corresponding to spiritual grades.

attributions.surface_quote: In the first sphere... the grades were from one to seven.

canonical_statement: Spirits can inhabit and derive sustenance from the physical and emotional states of mortal beings.

attributions.surface_quote: vampire spirits... inhabit gormandizers... absorbing their spiritual sustenance.

canonical_statement: The population of the spirit realms significantly exceeds the population of the mortal earth.

attributions.surface_quote: forty-eight times more people than the mortal inhabitants of the earth.

canonical_statement: Subjective heavens exist as specialized, non-fixed locations for learning and visitation.

attributions.surface_quote: the subjective heaven, a visiting place, and with but a small fixed population.

canonical_statement: The structure of the physical and spiritual universe is modeled after the hierarchical organization of higher celestial realms.

attributions.surface_quote: After the manner of the government of the etherean heavens do I these things.

canonical_statement: The universe is composed of nested, interconnected spheres and kingdoms that function as a unified whole.

attributions.surface_quote: forming one great kingdom with many parts

canonical_statement: Human faculties are intended for active development rather than dormancy.

attributions.surface_quote: I gave none of these capacities to man to lie dormant or to be useless.

canonical_statement: Spiritual advancement requires the full cultivation of all human talents.

attributions.surface_quote: He shall be perfected in all particulars before he is capacitated for companionship.

canonical_statement: Spiritual maturity is determined by the development of talents through labor, not by earthly social status.

attributions.surface_quote: It is not the kind of labor, but the development that comes of useful practice.

canonical_statement: Earthly hierarchies are inverted in the afterlife based on individual spiritual development.

attributions.surface_quote: The ranks and caste in my kingdoms seem to them to be upside-down.

canonical_statement: The afterlife contains educational and vocational structures analogous to those on earth.

attributions.surface_quote: God established... schools and colleges and factories, heavenly, adapted to the spirits.

canonical_statement: The spiritual hierarchy of the universe is divided into legitimate divine kingdoms and illegitimate, parasitic kingdoms.

attributions.surface_quote: Aside from the orderly kingdoms of God, there were seven false kingdoms in hada.

canonical_statement: Entities in the afterlife can exert coercive control over large populations of subordinate spirits.

attributions.surface_quote: Baal, with four thousand million angel slaves.

canonical_statement: The progression of the earth through specific cosmic regions influences the state of consciousness in the lower heavens.

attributions.surface_quote: The travel of the earth would cause her to pass through an a’ji’an forest.

canonical_statement: The actions and lives of mortals are systematically monitored and recorded for storage in celestial archives.

attributions.surface_quote: God sent down... inspectors and numerators and recorders to prepare the record of mortals.

canonical_statement: The physical earth and its associated heavens are subject to cyclical periods of darkness and atmospheric changes known as a'ji.

attributions.surface_quote: A’ji of four hundred years will reign upon the earth and her heavens.

canonical_statement: The spiritual evolution and habitation of the earth are governed by a hierarchy of divine beings acting under a supreme creator.

attributions.surface_quote: Such was the army sent down to the earth according to God’s command.

canonical_statement: The survival and spiritual status of specific human populations are contingent upon the environmental and spiritual conditions of the earth's vortex.

attributions.surface_quote: The darkness which is necessary to the earth will be too much for them.

attributions.surface_quote: The heavens that have heretofore received their spirits shall be dissolved.

canonical_statement: Non-corporeal entities monitor and record the status, spiritual development, and demographic data of human populations.

attributions.surface_quote: returned from their voyage to the earth, and brought records of the standing of mortals

canonical_statement: Human spiritual status is categorized into distinct grades and generational lineages.

attributions.surface_quote: records of the standing of mortals... and of their numbers, and their grades and generations

canonical_statement: The majority of human beings possess the potential for eternal existence.

attributions.surface_quote: upward of ninety-seven per cent, were capable of everlasting life.

canonical_statement: The educational framework of a society determines its long-term doctrinal foundation.

attributions.surface_quote: Whoso shapeth the education of a people will ultimately found them in their own doctrines.

canonical_statement: Linguistic diversity acts as a structural impediment to the collective advancement of a population.

attributions.surface_quote: No people can advance much whilst they have many languages.

canonical_statement: Ethical conduct and spiritual purity influence the physical and spiritual integrity of an individual.

attributions.surface_quote: Leviticans... were of imperfect flesh and spirit.

canonical_statement: The absence of centralized coercive authority is compatible with large-scale human populations.

attributions.surface_quote: not amongst all these millions of people one tyrant or dictator

attributions.surface_quote: Baal... hastened to the scene... to inspire the Israelites to glory in the Lord.

attributions.surface_quote: The others... remained true to the secret name and Person, Jehovih.

attributions.surface_quote: Millions of the Israelites fell beneath his power and became his spiritual slaves.

attributions.surface_quote: Having lost your kingdoms, why will you lose yourselves?

attributions.surface_quote: But satan (self) gained access to their souls

attributions.surface_quote: war can only be overcome by war

attributions.surface_quote: many of the Lords were without kingdoms

attributions.surface_quote: Our kingdoms and high places have fallen to pieces from no fault of our own.

attributions.surface_quote: Is it not wiser that ye join together, and go and deliver them?

canonical_statement: The universe provides foresight and pathways for inevitable periods of darkness and transition.

attributions.surface_quote: Jehovih hath furnished us roadways beforehand; and His Voice came to us prophesying.

attributions.surface_quote: They assembled in places of their own, and began to philosophize on the ways.

canonical_statement: The denial of the personal nature of the Divine leads to the deification of the intermediaries by the collective consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: Having denied His Person, then will ye yourselves become the Person in the understanding of the multitude.

canonical_statement: Organizational structures in the afterlife are hierarchical and capable of forming confederacies to manage spiritual domains.

attributions.surface_quote: They resolved to organize each one of these three places with a distinct head.

canonical_statement: The development of human history and the birth of significant individuals are orchestrated by celestial entities through the manipulation of mortal lineages.

attributions.surface_quote: thou shalt go down to the earth... and by inspiration bring forth a birth

canonical_statement: The efficacy of a spiritual teacher's doctrine is dependent upon the simultaneous incarnation of a supportive cohort of disciples.

attributions.surface_quote: it is wisdom to have also born into the mortal world... such hosts of philosophers as shall follow him

canonical_statement: Mortal consciousness and capacity are subject to external spiritual influence and design.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 14 GOD PROVIDETH FOR THE BIRTH OF KA’YU.
attributions.surface_quote: thou preparest for his birth by thy mastery over the generations of mortals

canonical_statement: Higher spiritual entities orchestrate human incarnations to influence historical and religious developments.

canonical_statement: The renunciation of worldly status and material attachment is a necessary condition for spiritual enlightenment and service to the Divine.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 15 GOD PROVIDETH FOR THE BIRTH OF SAKAYA.
attributions.surface_quote: He will forsake his kingdom and family... and make himself as a poor man.

canonical_statement: Spiritual progress requires the transcendence of social structures, such as caste and kinship, in favor of divine allegiance.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 15 GOD PROVIDETH FOR THE BIRTH OF SAKAYA.
attributions.surface_quote: Jehovih shall stand uppermost, even above kin and caste.

canonical_statement: The efficacy of a spiritual teacher's mission is dependent upon the pre-arranged alignment of disciples and environmental conditions.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou shalt provide unto this man many disciples... for without these, his preaching would be of little avail.

canonical_statement: Divine authority delegates the orchestration of human incarnation to specific spiritual entities.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 15 GOD PROVIDETH FOR THE BIRTH OF SAKAYA.
attributions.surface_quote: God crowned Etchessa... to bring into the world the heir, SAKAYA.

canonical_statement: Spiritual beings act as agents of divine will in the physical manifestation of historical figures.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 15 GOD PROVIDETH FOR THE BIRTH OF SAKAYA.
attributions.surface_quote: Thus were loo’is empowered of God, to bring into the world the heir.

canonical_statement: Spiritual trauma or fixation can create a repetitive psychological state that persists even after death.

attributions.surface_quote: He is distracted, continually using the same words over and over, without ceasing.

canonical_statement: The intensity of higher-dimensional light can exacerbate the suffering of spirits trapped in lower states of consciousness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: the light made him more distracted than before.

canonical_statement: A spiritual entity may be bound by the specific influence or curse of another individual, requiring that individual's intervention for release.

attributions.surface_quote: Perhaps Moses put a curse upon him! If so, only Moses can deliver him.

canonical_statement: The consequences of moral judgments made by individuals persist across time and space until rectified by the author of the judgment.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: If Moses put a judgment on Nu-ghan, then must Moses return to deliver him.

canonical_statement: Divine justice is omnipresent and inescapable, eventually compelling individuals to confront and resolve their past actions.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: The justice of Jehovih reacheth to all time and place.

canonical_statement: Spiritual evolution requires the reversal of past condemnations through the active exercise of forgiveness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: Instead of this, I should have forgiven him. I have sinned before Thee.

canonical_statement: The soul retains memory of past actions across vast temporal scales, which can be reawakened to facilitate spiritual correction.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: Thou hast awakened in me that which slept all these hundreds of years.

canonical_statement: Individual actions and historical epochs are orchestrated by the Creator to fulfill a divine timeline.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: All things are done by Jehovih, in His own way and time.

canonical_statement: Spiritual debt incurred through past actions necessitates future cycles of service and reincarnation.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: As I have been bound to come back to deliver thee, so shalt thou return.

canonical_statement: Higher spiritual beings can influence and inspire the actions of humans on earth.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: Thou and thy hosts shall select and inspire such of the Israelites.

canonical_statement: The Creator acts as the ultimate source of power and deliverance for all beings.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: Through Him is all deliverance, worlds without end.

canonical_statement: Actions performed during mortal life create inescapable karmic bonds that persist in the afterlife.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: I was bound to my kingdom, and obliged in the end to yield.

canonical_statement: Subjective memory of past actions and relationships functions as an inescapable tether in the spiritual realms.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: If I went away objectively, then subjectively I remembered them, and was drawn back.

canonical_statement: The soul possesses an inherent immortality that prevents total annihilation even under extreme suffering.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: I felt a sinking and a fainting, like an endless death, that could not extinguish me.

canonical_statement: Spiritual identity can be altered or masked through external symbolic intervention to evade karmic pursuers.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: I will give thee a new name, and I will clothe thee in garments.

canonical_statement: Higher entities possess the capacity to bestow spiritual identity and purpose upon lesser beings through symbolic investiture.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: Moses gathered up of the yellow, cloud-like mantle, and clothed Nu-ghan; and he named him, Illaes.

canonical_statement: The spiritual hierarchy maintains a structured communication network between the terrestrial realm and higher planes of existence.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 16 MOSES IN HEAVEN PAYETH THE JUDGMENT OF JEHOVIH!
attributions.surface_quote: God appointed one hundred messengers unto Pharaoh, that word might be transmitted every month to Paradise.

canonical_statement: The afterlife is structured into distinct regions and hierarchical heavenly kingdoms.

attributions.surface_quote: Moses departed for his own heavenly place in Nirvania.

canonical_statement: Spiritual entities can influence and direct the development of mortal societies through direct intervention.

attributions.surface_quote: Moses established them with nurseries, hospitals and factories.

canonical_statement: The nature of the Divine is fundamentally either an omnipresent spirit or a localized anthropomorphic deity.

attributions.surface_quote: Believing the Great Spirit was only a large man in heaven.

canonical_statement: Conflict among spiritual hierarchies in the afterlife manifests as corresponding conflict in the mortal realm.

attributions.surface_quote: These Gods will not only war in heaven, but they will carry their battles down to mortals.

canonical_statement: Divine entities compete for the allegiance of spiritual beings and mortals to sustain their influence.

attributions.surface_quote: Baal and Ashtaroth are in conflict and neglectful of the temples

canonical_statement: Spiritual entities (angels) possess a higher value or utility to divine powers than mortal beings.

attributions.surface_quote: Better is it, that these false Gods win unto themselves as dutiful subjects, five angels, than one mortal.

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of the universe is an impersonal expanse rather than a personal deity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 18 THE MEANING AND ORIGIN OF THE TERM, HOLY GHOST!
attributions.surface_quote: We say: Behold the all expanse; it is but a shadow, a ghost.

canonical_statement: Individual autonomy and the right to independent judgment are inherent to developed consciousness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 18 THE MEANING AND ORIGIN OF THE TERM, HOLY GHOST!
attributions.surface_quote: When I was a child, I was helped to walk; but now I am strong, I walk alone.

canonical_statement: The existence of an All-Person implies a state of servitude to a higher will.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 18 THE MEANING AND ORIGIN OF THE TERM, HOLY GHOST!
attributions.surface_quote: If thou be right, and this thing be an All Person, thou art then His servant.

canonical_statement: Moral and metaphysical doctrines are validated by the capacity for self-governance and the rejection of external dominion.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 18 THE MEANING AND ORIGIN OF THE TERM, HOLY GHOST!
attributions.surface_quote: As thou claimest liberty to think and to speak for thyself, so do we all.

canonical_statement: The universe operates according to immutable law rather than the direct agency of a singular Divine Spirit.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 18 THE MEANING AND ORIGIN OF THE TERM, HOLY GHOST!
attributions.surface_quote: all things are by law; and the word, law, shall take the place of Jehovih.

canonical_statement: The denial of a singular, supreme Creator necessitates the creation of idolatrous, fragmented representations of divinity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 18 THE MEANING AND ORIGIN OF THE TERM, HOLY GHOST!
attributions.surface_quote: they, who deny an All Highest Person in the Creator, become establishers of idolatry.

canonical_statement: The justification of punitive violence against perceived wickedness inevitably leads to the proliferation of evil and social collapse.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 18 THE MEANING AND ORIGIN OF THE TERM, HOLY GHOST!
attributions.surface_quote: Because ye say: Give punishment to the wicked, ye open the door of all evil.

canonical_statement: Entities who reject the unity of the Creator are destined to eventually claim divine status for themselves.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 18 THE MEANING AND ORIGIN OF THE TERM, HOLY GHOST!
attributions.surface_quote: each of ye three Gods will be forced to announce himself as such.

canonical_statement: The exercise of dominion over others inevitably leads to the degradation of the ruler's moral state.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 34 GOD JUDGETH THE GOVERNMENTS OF MAN.

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of human development is the transcendence of external governance in favor of self-directed righteousness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 35 GOD DECLARETH AGAINST THE GOVERNMENTS OF MAN.
attributions.surface_quote: Whoso liveth with Jehovih is free from Jehovih. These need no man’s government.

canonical_statement: Historical legal structures serve as developmental tools for human judgment rather than permanent moral requirements.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 35 GOD DECLARETH AGAINST THE GOVERNMENTS OF MAN.
attributions.surface_quote: These laws and governments were for the past eras; they shaped man’s judgment.

canonical_statement: The accumulation of knowledge necessitates a shift from external regulation to individual autonomy.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 35 GOD DECLARETH AGAINST THE GOVERNMENTS OF MAN.
attributions.surface_quote: From the acquisition of knowledge a new liberty hath been born.

canonical_statement: The only valid basis for collective law is the demonstrated demand of the public, rather than preemptive protection.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 35 GOD DECLARETH AGAINST THE GOVERNMENTS OF MAN.
attributions.surface_quote: To make such laws beforehand, is to sin against Jehovih.

canonical_statement: Spiritual accountability is defined by the fulfillment of individual capacity rather than adherence to ritualistic or temporal observances.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 35 GOD DECLARETH AGAINST THE GOVERNMENTS OF MAN.
attributions.surface_quote: Accountability shall be unto all men, whether they fulfill in wisdom their utmost capacities.

canonical_statement: The necessity and rigidity of external law are inversely proportional to the spiritual maturity of the individual.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 35 GOD DECLARETH AGAINST THE GOVERNMENTS OF MAN.
attributions.surface_quote: To the bad and evil-minded, rigid laws; but to the wise, go without laws.

canonical_statement: The physical body is a temporary instrument provided to facilitate the acquisition of earthly knowledge.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 35 GOD DECLARETH AGAINST THE GOVERNMENTS OF MAN.
attributions.surface_quote: To man I gave an earthly body that he might learn earthly things.

canonical_statement: Death is a purposeful mechanism designed to transition the soul into higher states of existence.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 35 GOD DECLARETH AGAINST THE GOVERNMENTS OF MAN.
attributions.surface_quote: Death I gave to man that he might rise to the inheritance of My heavenly kingdoms.

canonical_statement: All life originates from and returns to the Creator, who maintains sovereignty over both the living and the dead.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 35 GOD DECLARETH AGAINST THE GOVERNMENTS OF MAN.
attributions.surface_quote: Jehovih created alive, and Jehovih taketh life away, for all things are His.

canonical_statement: The duration of an individual's life is divinely ordained to facilitate the acquisition of wisdom and the manifestation of divine purpose.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 35 GOD DECLARETH AGAINST THE GOVERNMENTS OF MAN.
attributions.surface_quote: He appointeth a time unto all... to result in wisdom and happiness

canonical_statement: The evolution of human religious systems is directed by divine intelligence to meet the changing requirements of humanity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 36 GOD SHOWETH HOW HE HATH WROUGHT.
attributions.surface_quote: God hath labored to prepare unto the generations of this day.

canonical_statement: Divine intelligence intentionally permits the corruption of sacred texts to facilitate the eventual transition to new religious frameworks.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 36 GOD SHOWETH HOW HE HATH WROUGHT.
attributions.surface_quote: He had permitted corruptions and contradictions to creep into the sacred books.

canonical_statement: Historical events, including the rise of secular scholarship and global commerce, are orchestrated by divine influence to dismantle obsolete social and religious structures.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 36 GOD SHOWETH HOW HE HATH WROUGHT.
attributions.surface_quote: I went to work systematically, inspiring man to accomplish even what man hath accomplished.

canonical_statement: Miraculous phenomena are not evidence of divine status or inherent worthiness of worship.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 36 GOD SHOWETH HOW HE HATH WROUGHT.
attributions.surface_quote: no man nor God is worthy to be worshipped because of miracles.

canonical_statement: The capacity to perform miracles is a latent human potential accessible to both virtuous and non-virtuous individuals.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 36 GOD SHOWETH HOW HE HATH WROUGHT.
attributions.surface_quote: I give these powers unto good and bad men, and unto good and bad women.

canonical_statement: Spiritual resurrection is achieved through the cultivation of wisdom and good works rather than supernatural displays.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 36 GOD SHOWETH HOW HE HATH WROUGHT.
attributions.surface_quote: good works and wisdom shall be, henceforth, the means of resurrection in heaven.

canonical_statement: Collective harmony and social unity are the necessary conditions for the manifestation of significant progress for humanity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 36 GOD SHOWETH HOW HE HATH WROUGHT.
attributions.surface_quote: only by harmony and the union of many, can any great good come.

canonical_statement: The universe operates according to a structured, systematic, and orderly divine methodology.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 37 GOD REVEALETH HIS METHOD OF WORK.
attributions.surface_quote: Think not, O man, that thy God goeth about a work without a system.

canonical_statement: Divine entities influence human biological lineage and reproductive outcomes to facilitate specific historical or spiritual objectives.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 37 GOD REVEALETH HIS METHOD OF WORK.
attributions.surface_quote: My loo’is, by inspiration, control the marriages of certain mortals.

canonical_statement: Divine entities actively manipulate human genetics and birth circumstances to fulfill specific cosmic agendas.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 37 GOD REVEALETH HIS METHOD OF WORK.
attributions.surface_quote: my loo’is shaped mortal births to bring about the armies of thy God.

canonical_statement: Human life is a testing ground where individual actions are recorded by celestial beings for post-mortem evaluation.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 37 GOD REVEALETH HIS METHOD OF WORK.
attributions.surface_quote: Try ye all mortals, and make a register of them and their behavior.

canonical_statement: Spiritual abandonment occurs when individuals prioritize self-interest over divine purpose, leaving them vulnerable to malevolent entities.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 37 GOD REVEALETH HIS METHOD OF WORK.
attributions.surface_quote: I shall withdraw my holy angels away from such rich people, and they shall be left to fall into the obsession of drujas.

canonical_statement: The ultimate purpose of human existence is the establishment of a unified, harmonious global society under divine law.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 37 GOD REVEALETH HIS METHOD OF WORK.
attributions.surface_quote: To give man the system of universal peace, love, harmony and kosmon.

canonical_statement: Human actions and internal convictions are recorded and monitored by higher celestial intelligences.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 37 GOD REVEALETH HIS METHOD OF WORK.
attributions.surface_quote: all such matters were recorded in my heavens

canonical_statement: Spiritual guidance is withdrawn from individuals who prioritize personal gain or earthly concerns over collective spiritual evolution.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 37 GOD REVEALETH HIS METHOD OF WORK.
attributions.surface_quote: I commanded my holy angels to withdraw from all mortals who were not working

canonical_statement: The soul's susceptibility to lower-order entities (drujas) is influenced by the individual's alignment with self-interest versus universal service.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 37 GOD REVEALETH HIS METHOD OF WORK.
attributions.surface_quote: many whom I had designed for exalted work, fell into the hands of drujas

canonical_statement: Spiritual election is a reciprocal process involving both individual volition and divine selection.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 37 GOD REVEALETH HIS METHOD OF WORK.
attributions.surface_quote: Ye, that choose to serve Jehovih, behold, Jehovih hath chosen you also

attributions.chapter: Chapter 38 GOD SHOWETH THE MISTAKES OF MAN’S JUDGMENT.
attributions.surface_quote: In a new cycle man ever runneth to the extreme opposite of the old errors.

canonical_statement: The spiritual evolution of a new era is predicated on the cultivation of the young rather than the conversion of adults.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 38 GOD SHOWETH THE MISTAKES OF MAN’S JUDGMENT.
attributions.surface_quote: I labor not so much to convert adults, as to prepare the minds of the young.

canonical_statement: Higher spiritual labor requires the transcendence of biological reproduction and earthly passions.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 38 GOD SHOWETH THE MISTAKES OF MAN’S JUDGMENT.
attributions.surface_quote: My laborers shall not have desire to be either fathers or mothers.

canonical_statement: The structure of a new spiritual order must be synthesized from the proven wisdom of the past.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 38 GOD SHOWETH THE MISTAKES OF MAN’S JUDGMENT.
attributions.surface_quote: The new edifice shall be of all that was good of the past.

canonical_statement: Human beings are fundamentally spiritual entities manifesting in physical form.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 38 GOD SHOWETH THE MISTAKES OF MAN’S JUDGMENT.
attributions.surface_quote: they, themselves, are angels in mortal form

canonical_statement: The physical and spiritual development of humans is directly influenced by environmental, dietary, and social conditions.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 38 GOD SHOWETH THE MISTAKES OF MAN’S JUDGMENT.

canonical_statement: Divine oversight and blessing are contingent upon the moral and spiritual qualities of the individual.
