attributions.chapter: Chapter 21 OF THE VOICE OF JEHOVIH.
attributions.surface_quote: I am Spirit; I am the Soul of things.

canonical_statement: The Divine Presence acts as an upward pull toward higher consciousness, while material attachment acts as a downward pull.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 21 OF THE VOICE OF JEHOVIH.
attributions.surface_quote: I am as one on the top of a mountain, calling to all people.

canonical_statement: Divine communication is perceived through experiences that elevate the soul, while experiences that degrade the soul obscure it.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 21 OF THE VOICE OF JEHOVIH.
attributions.surface_quote: whatsoever thou hearest... that riseth thee upward, the same is My Voice.

canonical_statement: The ability to perceive the Divine is an innate faculty seated within the soul, capable of growth through cultivation.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 21 OF THE VOICE OF JEHOVIH.
attributions.surface_quote: It is a talent to hear Me; I bestowed it upon all the living.

canonical_statement: Human conscience is a manifestation of the Divine Voice, often perceived as faint due to the individual's internal darkness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 21 OF THE VOICE OF JEHOVIH.
attributions.surface_quote: When My Voice is weak... he calleth Me conscience.

canonical_statement: The purification of the self and the pursuit of wisdom are necessary conditions for the conscious reception of Divine guidance.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 21 OF THE VOICE OF JEHOVIH.
attributions.surface_quote: Whoso hath not heard Me... hath not yet turned his thoughts inward to purify himself.

canonical_statement: Individual autonomy and personal judgment are the primary mechanisms for spiritual discernment.

attributions.surface_quote: judge thou, in thine own way, what is best for thee

canonical_statement: Mortal existence is inherently imperfect and lacks the quality of immaculacy.

attributions.surface_quote: Nothing mortal is immaculate

canonical_statement: The ultimate authority for moral and spiritual judgment resides in the Divine rather than human institutions.

attributions.surface_quote: Go thou to Jehovih, and inquire of Him.

canonical_statement: The ultimate authority and leader of all beings is the Divine, precluding human hierarchy.

attributions.surface_quote: Who is the head? Ye shall answer them, saying: Jehovih.

canonical_statement: All individuals possess equal ontological status regardless of their functional differences in strength or wisdom.

attributions.surface_quote: Why, then, shall we give any preference to one over another?

canonical_statement: Individual differences in capacity are divinely ordained for the purpose of communal service rather than social stratification.

attributions.surface_quote: He designed the strong ones to carry heavier burdens than the weak.

canonical_statement: The absence of possessive concepts in early development prevents the formation of selfish desire.

attributions.surface_quote: Because they had never known to say: This is mine... they were without selfishness.

canonical_statement: Human purpose is defined by the service of others and the manifestation of divine will.

attributions.surface_quote: We were created in order to help rescue the world... and do good unto others.

canonical_statement: Biological and spiritual traits are transmissible and can be refined through environmental and behavioral conditioning.

attributions.surface_quote: The offspring begotten of these were indeed a new race... as to wisdom, love, purity.

canonical_statement: Innate spiritual perception (su'is) allows for the acquisition of knowledge independent of physical instruction.

attributions.surface_quote: They were by birth so developed in su’is, that... education came to them without books.

canonical_statement: The boundary between the physical and spiritual realms is permeable to those with developed spiritual faculties.

attributions.surface_quote: The heavens were as an open book; the libraries of the heavens as the sound of voices.

canonical_statement: The highest form of social organization is governed by direct divine inspiration rather than human law or hierarchy.

attributions.surface_quote: none of these colonies were bound by written laws, nor had any of them leaders

canonical_statement: Individual ownership is an illusion; all material resources are held in trust for the Divine.

attributions.surface_quote: all things were Jehovih’s, in care of the keeping of the colony.

canonical_statement: Labor performed for the Divine transcends economic utility and transactional value.

attributions.surface_quote: Neither labored any one for the colony, but for Jehovih

canonical_statement: The Divine intentionally segregates humanity into distinct groups based on their spiritual responsiveness and adherence to moral duty.

attributions.surface_quote: Jehovih separated the people, the Uzians on one hand, and the Faithists on the other.

canonical_statement: Spiritual accountability is determined by an individual's failure to act against societal vices and moral decay.

attributions.surface_quote: Because ye rose not up, saying: Stay thy hand, satan!

canonical_statement: Moral transgressions by individuals inevitably result in proportional consequences for the collective entity or nation.

attributions.surface_quote: the same responsibility and result would befall a nation or a people

canonical_statement: Divine intervention and spiritual guidance are contingent upon the moral alignment of the recipient.

attributions.surface_quote: I shall withdraw from your cities... And not answer ye their prayers

canonical_statement: The withdrawal of divine influence allows for the manifestation of negative spiritual entities within human society.

attributions.surface_quote: angels of darkness shall come amongst them

canonical_statement: The Divine is the foundational principle and essence of all existence.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the First Principle in all things.

canonical_statement: Moral attributes such as justice, purity, and truth are identical with the Divine essence.

attributions.surface_quote: I am Justice; I am Purity.

canonical_statement: Human spiritual evolution is a progressive ascent that requires correction if one deviates from the path.

attributions.surface_quote: I made the way of life like going up a mountain.

canonical_statement: Collective responsibility for moral governance is inherent in self-governing societies.

attributions.surface_quote: When I gave unto the multitude to govern themselves, I gave also responsibility.

canonical_statement: The spiritual state of parents directly influences the behavioral and moral outcomes of their offspring.

attributions.surface_quote: As the fathers and mothers respected not Me, so came disrespect upon them.

canonical_statement: The state of the soul in the afterlife is a direct reflection of the individual's earthly conduct and attachments.

attributions.surface_quote: As ye bind yourselves on earth, even so shall ye be bound in heaven.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a conscious, personal entity rather than a collection of impersonal natural laws.

attributions.surface_quote: There is no All Person; there is nothing, save certain natural and divine laws.

canonical_statement: Spiritual evolution requires a fundamental reversal of one's current orientation and adherence to divine principles.

attributions.surface_quote: Except ye turn about, and begin anew, there is no help for you.

canonical_statement: Humanity is subject to a process of spiritual stratification based on the alignment of individual will with divine service.

attributions.surface_quote: I have separated the wheat from the chaff; I have divided the sheep from the goats.

canonical_statement: The divine principle of separation dictates that the righteous are periodically withdrawn from the influence of the wicked to ensure their preservation.

attributions.surface_quote: When I separate the people, the good go away out from amongst the evil.

canonical_statement: Spiritual prosperity and historical endurance are contingent upon alignment with divine will, while those who remain in iniquity face eventual oblivion.

attributions.surface_quote: Whoso go out, prosper in My hand; but those that remain, go down to destruction.

canonical_statement: The progression of history is governed by a moral law where might derived from wrongdoing is inherently unstable and subject to divine judgment.

attributions.surface_quote: Might shall not triumph through wrong-doing. Behold, a judgment shall come upon this people.

canonical_statement: The ultimate locus of spiritual and national security is internal rather than external.

attributions.surface_quote: this nation... shall not be attacked in the places ye build. It is within.

canonical_statement: The progression of a society's moral state is inversely correlated with the spiritual migration of the righteous.

attributions.surface_quote: in proportion as ye go down in corruption, even so shall the Faithists go away

canonical_statement: The divine entity acts as the architect of historical and temporal events.

attributions.surface_quote: My hands fashioned the signs of the times.

canonical_statement: Material force and defensive technology are ineffective against spiritual or metaphysical corruption.

attributions.surface_quote: By force and by might, ye shall hope to overcome the prince of devils, but ye shall fail.

canonical_statement: Democratic governance based on majority rule is inherently limited and cannot attain the highest spiritual light.

attributions.surface_quote: A republic can not follow the highest Light; it followeth the majority.

canonical_statement: The ultimate triumph of any system is contingent upon its alignment with the All Highest.

attributions.surface_quote: only the All Highest can triumph in the end

canonical_statement: The highest state of human social organization is the absence of coercive, man-made government.

attributions.surface_quote: man was without a government, such as man’s government. And this was the next higher condition

canonical_statement: Humanity is divided into two distinct spiritual categories: those aligned with the Spirit and those aligned with the flesh.

attributions.surface_quote: those that were of the Spirit believed; but those that were of the flesh disbelieved.

canonical_statement: Spiritual orientation determines the trajectory of the soul, leading either to wisdom and purity or to darkness and dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: believers... rising higher and higher in wisdom and purity. But the disbelievers went down in darkness.

canonical_statement: External societal and governmental structures are incapable of achieving divine order or true peace.

attributions.surface_quote: all these things shall fail. Trust ye not in the ungodly to do a godlike matter.

canonical_statement: The Divine presence acts directly upon the human soul to provide guidance.

attributions.surface_quote: Jehovih speaking in the souls of mortals.

canonical_statement: Human beings possess the potential to evolve into divine beings through successive stages of resurrection.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 1 GOD REVEALETH WHO HE IS.
attributions.surface_quote: as I am thy elder brother, so shall it be with thee, to rise

canonical_statement: The ultimate source of all existence is an incomprehensible, omnipresent, and immanent force.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 1 GOD REVEALETH WHO HE IS.
attributions.surface_quote: He is within all; beyond and over all: Being Ever Present

canonical_statement: The universe is structured into hierarchical levels of existence, with specific deities governing localized heavenly realms.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 1 GOD REVEALETH WHO HE IS.
attributions.surface_quote: a God and organic heavens belonging to each and all of them

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness undergoes a series of distinct transitions, moving from mortality to increasingly higher states of wisdom and power.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 1 GOD REVEALETH WHO HE IS.
attributions.surface_quote: First, mortality, then death... Second, angel organization... third resurrection

canonical_statement: The supreme creative force is distinct from the administrative deities who govern specific planetary heavens.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 1 GOD REVEALETH WHO HE IS.
attributions.surface_quote: God and Jehovih, are not the same one

canonical_statement: The state of being a spirit is a continuation of human identity after physical death.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 1 GOD REVEALETH WHO HE IS.
attributions.surface_quote: I am as any other spirit of the dead, a one time man

canonical_statement: The afterlife exists within a structured, organic celestial environment associated with the Earth.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 1 GOD REVEALETH WHO HE IS.
attributions.surface_quote: one within the organic heavens of the earth

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness persists beyond the death of the physical body.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 2 GOD EXPLAINETH THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTION, AND THE DIFFERENCE IN MANIFESTATIONS FROM THEM.
attributions.surface_quote: the souls of the dead do live

canonical_statement: Disembodied spirits retain the personality traits and biases they possessed during their mortal life.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 2 GOD EXPLAINETH THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTION, AND THE DIFFERENCE IN MANIFESTATIONS FROM THEM.
attributions.surface_quote: spirits of the dead possess... the same characteristics and prejudices as when in mortality

canonical_statement: All living humans are subject to the influence of disembodied spirits, regardless of their conscious awareness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 2 GOD EXPLAINETH THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTION, AND THE DIFFERENCE IN MANIFESTATIONS FROM THEM.
attributions.surface_quote: all people are subject to the influence of the spirits of the dead

canonical_statement: The initial state of post-mortem existence, the first resurrection, encompasses all souls regardless of their moral or intellectual development.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 2 GOD EXPLAINETH THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTION, AND THE DIFFERENCE IN MANIFESTATIONS FROM THEM.
attributions.surface_quote: all of these as well as the wise and good enter the first resurrection

canonical_statement: The spiritual hierarchy is divided into distinct levels of resurrection based on the renunciation of lower earthly associations.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 2 GOD EXPLAINETH THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTION, AND THE DIFFERENCE IN MANIFESTATIONS FROM THEM.
attributions.surface_quote: The condition of membership required the renunciation of all associations and conditions below it.

canonical_statement: Higher spiritual entities avoid direct individual manifestation to mortals to prevent the displacement of worship from the Creator to the spirits.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 2 GOD EXPLAINETH THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTION, AND THE DIFFERENCE IN MANIFESTATIONS FROM THEM.
attributions.surface_quote: Angels of Jehovih should never manifest themselves as individuals unto mortals.

canonical_statement: Spiritual influence on mortals occurs through two primary modes: direct inspiration of the internal consciousness or abnormal manipulation via entrancement.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 2 GOD EXPLAINETH THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTION, AND THE DIFFERENCE IN MANIFESTATIONS FROM THEM.
attributions.surface_quote: Individual entity of a mortal is directed in its normal growth; but by the angels of the first resurrection, mortals are used abnormally.

canonical_statement: The evolution of the soul is an eternal process of upward movement toward higher heavenly states.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 2 GOD EXPLAINETH THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTION, AND THE DIFFERENCE IN MANIFESTATIONS FROM THEM.
attributions.surface_quote: My heavens are for raising the soul upward for ever and ever.

canonical_statement: The spiritual hierarchy is structured into organized, disciplined ranks such as Lords and Captains.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 2 GOD EXPLAINETH THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTION, AND THE DIFFERENCE IN MANIFESTATIONS FROM THEM.
attributions.surface_quote: Chief angels over these phalanxes being Lords, Marshals, Captains, and so on.

canonical_statement: Higher spiritual beings influence human consciousness through dreams, thoughts, and visions.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 2 GOD EXPLAINETH THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTION, AND THE DIFFERENCE IN MANIFESTATIONS FROM THEM.
attributions.surface_quote: provide dreams, thoughts and visions in the minds of mortals.

canonical_statement: Spiritual truth is universal, but its delivery is adapted to the varying intellectual capacities of human populations.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 2 GOD EXPLAINETH THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTION, AND THE DIFFERENCE IN MANIFESTATIONS FROM THEM.
attributions.surface_quote: different grades and systems adapted to the different degrees of intelligence.

canonical_statement: The spiritual state of an individual is determined by the alignment of their desires with those of discarnate entities.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: mortals and angels to attract each other

canonical_statement: The mortal world and the spirit world exist in a state of constant, permeable contact.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: the spirit world ever in contact with the mortal world

canonical_statement: Psychic and emotional states are transferred between mortals and spirits through proximity and resonance.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: by angel contact with the spirit of man, knowledge passeth

canonical_statement: Spirits may remain bound to the earth plane due to attachment to earthly desires and refusal to ascend.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: many of them will not hence into the higher heavens

canonical_statement: Spiritual progression requires the systematic abandonment of earthly habits and desires.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: raising up everlastingly is by constantly putting away the conditions below.

canonical_statement: Divine revelation is constant in essence but increases in fullness relative to human capacity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: inspiration... varieth... not... save in greater fullness, according to the increase of capacity.

canonical_statement: The afterlife contains states of purgation and bondage for those not yet purified.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: none could rise till made organically pure; there is bondage after death.

canonical_statement: Higher spiritual entities operate as collective legions rather than distinct individual personalities.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: Thy God cometh not as an individual; I come in legions.

canonical_statement: Heaven is structured by divine government, discipline, and order.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: In heaven there is organization, God, Holy Council, discipline, and order.

canonical_statement: The doctrine of reincarnation through successive biological and mineral forms is a false teaching associated with the first resurrection.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: Resurrection cometh by reincarnation--first a stone, then lead, then silver, then gold.

canonical_statement: Spiritual entities claiming authority based on celestial origin or past planetary travel are deceptive influences.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: Who saith: I have visited the planets... these are the utterances of the angels.

canonical_statement: Spiritual communication that emphasizes personal mission or ancient spirit attendance is a form of flattery that leads to suffering.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: Blessed art thou; for a host of ancient spirits attend thee--thou hast a great mission.

canonical_statement: The soul evolves through two distinct stages of consciousness, characterized by a transition from ego-centric self-assertion to selfless surrender to the Divine.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: Difference of method betwixt the first and second resurrections.

canonical_statement: The second stage of spiritual resurrection involves the total relinquishment of personal rights and the acceptance of divine will over individual autonomy.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: I ask not for rights for my own self; whatsoever is put upon me, that will I bear.

canonical_statement: Spiritual maturity is marked by the shift from seeking external validation to seeking alignment with the Divine perspective.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: What will Jehovih say? With Him must I preserve my reputation.

canonical_statement: The soul's ultimate state of being is defined by universal kinship and the rejection of preferential treatment for the self or kin.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: We are all brothers and sisters; why shall we prefer one of Jehovih’s children?

canonical_statement: True spiritual purification requires constant self-examination and the surrender of personal judgment to the Divine.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 3 GOD ILLUSTRATETH THE DIFFERENCE OF METHOD BETWIXT THE FIRST AND SECOND RESURRECTIONS.
attributions.surface_quote: Teach me, O Father, to look into my every act, word and thought.

canonical_statement: Spiritual perception and the ability to receive divine inspiration are contingent upon the internal purification of one's nature.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 5 GOD SHOWETH HOW MORTALS MAY ATTAIN INSPIRATION FROM JEHOVIH AND FROM THE ANGELS OF THE SECOND RESURRECTION.
attributions.surface_quote: till that man is purified and grown to be constitutionally temperate he is not temperate.

canonical_statement: The capacity to accurately judge spiritual truth is limited to those who have attained a corresponding level of spiritual development.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 5 GOD SHOWETH HOW MORTALS MAY ATTAIN INSPIRATION FROM JEHOVIH AND FROM THE ANGELS OF THE SECOND RESURRECTION.
attributions.surface_quote: Who then can judge him, save they have also attained to the same high estate?

canonical_statement: The physical universe is a direct, readable manifestation of the Divine, serving as a primary source of revelation.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 5 GOD SHOWETH HOW MORTALS MAY ATTAIN INSPIRATION FROM JEHOVIH AND FROM THE ANGELS OF THE SECOND RESURRECTION.
attributions.surface_quote: no book so easily read as His created universe.

canonical_statement: The quality of an individual's perception of heavenly reality is determined by their internal moral and spiritual state.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 5 GOD SHOWETH HOW MORTALS MAY ATTAIN INSPIRATION FROM JEHOVIH AND FROM THE ANGELS OF THE SECOND RESURRECTION.
attributions.surface_quote: The unholy man seeth heavenly things but dimly.

canonical_statement: The ultimate spiritual goal for humanity is the attainment of direct, autonomous communion with the Divine, bypassing external intermediaries.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 5 GOD SHOWETH HOW MORTALS MAY ATTAIN INSPIRATION FROM JEHOVIH AND FROM THE ANGELS OF THE SECOND RESURRECTION.
attributions.surface_quote: all men become constitutionally capable of receiving and comprehending the highest light.

canonical_statement: Human behavior is a primary instrument for manifesting divine order and peace within the material realm.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 5 GOD SHOWETH HOW MORTALS MAY ATTAIN INSPIRATION FROM JEHOVIH AND FROM THE ANGELS OF THE SECOND RESURRECTION.
attributions.surface_quote: behavior may make the earth a place of peace, for the glory of Jehovih.

canonical_statement: The ultimate purpose of human existence and societal harmony is the glorification of the Divine.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 5 GOD SHOWETH HOW MORTALS MAY ATTAIN INSPIRATION FROM JEHOVIH AND FROM THE ANGELS OF THE SECOND RESURRECTION.
attributions.surface_quote: for the glory of Jehovih.

canonical_statement: Moral actions are categorized as light or darkness based on their capacity to generate joy, peace, and goodwill versus sorrow and discouragement.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 6 OF JEHOVIH AND HIS KINGDOM ON EARTH.
attributions.surface_quote: whatsoever giveth joy to thy fellow... shall be called light

canonical_statement: Membership in the divine kingdom is determined by the alignment of one's actions with the principle of light.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 6 OF JEHOVIH AND HIS KINGDOM ON EARTH.
attributions.surface_quote: whoso becometh a member of my kingdom shall practice light

canonical_statement: Negative actions directed toward others create a karmic resonance that inevitably returns to the originator.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 6 OF JEHOVIH AND HIS KINGDOM ON EARTH.
attributions.surface_quote: all such inquisition cometh of darkness, and shall return upon him

canonical_statement: The elevation of another's spiritual state is achieved by recognizing and affirming the inherent good within them.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 6 OF JEHOVIH AND HIS KINGDOM ON EARTH.
attributions.surface_quote: discover the good that is in thy neighbor, and laud him therefor

canonical_statement: The divine is an eternal, omnipresent reality that transcends specific temporal eras.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 7 GOD SHOWETH THE DIFFERENCE BETWIXT THE RELIGION OF THE OLDEN TIME AND THAT OF THE PRESENT.
attributions.surface_quote: To the All One, Jehovih, now as in the olden time, and for all time to come.

canonical_statement: The individual's spiritual focus should be directed toward the highest conceivable ideal of perfection.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 7 GOD SHOWETH THE DIFFERENCE BETWIXT THE RELIGION OF THE OLDEN TIME AND THAT OF THE PRESENT.
attributions.surface_quote: The Highest Ideal, the Nearest Perfect the mind can conceive of--let such be thy Jehovih.

canonical_statement: Perception of others should be limited to the manifestation of their highest spiritual potential.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 7 GOD SHOWETH THE DIFFERENCE BETWIXT THE RELIGION OF THE OLDEN TIME AND THAT OF THE PRESENT.
attributions.surface_quote: The All Highest in thy neighbor which he manifesteth--that perceive and discourse upon.

canonical_statement: The focus of consciousness determines one's spiritual state, categorized as either 'darkness' or 'light'.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 7 GOD SHOWETH THE DIFFERENCE BETWIXT THE RELIGION OF THE OLDEN TIME AND THAT OF THE PRESENT.
attributions.surface_quote: The man of darkness delighteth to discourse... the man of light delighteth to apply himself.

canonical_statement: Spiritual evolution requires transitioning from self-centered salvation to the service and elevation of others.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 7 GOD SHOWETH THE DIFFERENCE BETWIXT THE RELIGION OF THE OLDEN TIME AND THAT OF THE PRESENT.
attributions.surface_quote: Go save others, and no longer concern yourselves about yourselves.

canonical_statement: Individual salvation is an automatic byproduct of elevating others, rendering personal concern for one's own soul unnecessary.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 7 GOD SHOWETH THE DIFFERENCE BETWIXT THE RELIGION OF THE OLDEN TIME AND THAT OF THE PRESENT.
attributions.surface_quote: If they raise others up... they are already saved.

canonical_statement: Religious development is progressive, moving from ego-based incentives to higher, selfless modes of existence.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 7 GOD SHOWETH THE DIFFERENCE BETWIXT THE RELIGION OF THE OLDEN TIME AND THAT OF THE PRESENT.
attributions.surface_quote: It being necessary to appeal to his own advantages... I come to give a great religion.

canonical_statement: The desire to seek the divine is sufficient evidence of the presence of divine light within an individual.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 7 GOD SHOWETH THE DIFFERENCE BETWIXT THE RELIGION OF THE OLDEN TIME AND THAT OF THE PRESENT.
attributions.surface_quote: Because any one desireth to come--that is sufficient testimony that the light of Jehovih is upon him.

canonical_statement: The practice of the highest spiritual principles naturally causes those of lower vibration to depart.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 7 GOD SHOWETH THE DIFFERENCE BETWIXT THE RELIGION OF THE OLDEN TIME AND THAT OF THE PRESENT.
attributions.surface_quote: When ye practice the all highest, behold, the others will depart away from you.

canonical_statement: Engaging with or judging darkness constitutes a descent into darkness itself.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 7 GOD SHOWETH THE DIFFERENCE BETWIXT THE RELIGION OF THE OLDEN TIME AND THAT OF THE PRESENT.
attributions.surface_quote: Answer them not, lest ye also practice darkness.

canonical_statement: Individual spiritual progress is a matter between the soul and the Creator, rather than a matter for external judgment.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 7 GOD SHOWETH THE DIFFERENCE BETWIXT THE RELIGION OF THE OLDEN TIME AND THAT OF THE PRESENT.
attributions.surface_quote: Because they do little, the matter is betwixt them and Jehovih.

canonical_statement: The ultimate mechanism for spiritual transformation is the power of personal example rather than coercion.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 7 GOD SHOWETH THE DIFFERENCE BETWIXT THE RELIGION OF THE OLDEN TIME AND THAT OF THE PRESENT.
attributions.surface_quote: Let your example heal them.

canonical_statement: True spiritual light is defined exclusively by verifiable facts, axioms, and demonstrable evidence rather than subjective opinion.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 8 GOD SHOWETH WHAT IS MEANT BY FOLLOWING THE HIGHEST LIGHT.
attributions.surface_quote: Only facts well known, or comparatively proven, are light. An opinion is not light.

canonical_statement: Spiritual authority and angelic communication must be subjected to the same rigorous evidentiary standards as human testimony.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 8 GOD SHOWETH WHAT IS MEANT BY FOLLOWING THE HIGHEST LIGHT.
attributions.surface_quote: Thou shalt weigh the words of angels even as if they were mortals.

canonical_statement: The highest light is manifested through the alignment of objective knowledge with ethical conduct and social upliftment.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 8 GOD SHOWETH WHAT IS MEANT BY FOLLOWING THE HIGHEST LIGHT.
attributions.surface_quote: Things that lead to peace, order, and the uplifting of thy neighbor and thyself.

canonical_statement: Subjective belief systems, when lacking empirical substantiation, constitute a state of spiritual darkness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 8 GOD SHOWETH WHAT IS MEANT BY FOLLOWING THE HIGHEST LIGHT.
attributions.surface_quote: Without these, then the supposed light is only darkness.

canonical_statement: Spiritual readiness for a higher kingdom is contingent upon the total renunciation of ego, selfishness, and individual autonomy in favor of collective service.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 9 GOD SHOWETH WHO IS AND WHO IS NOT PREPARED TO ENTER JEHOVIH’S KINGDOM ON EARTH.
attributions.surface_quote: I desire to put away my selfishness... I desire more to serve others than myself.

canonical_statement: The internal state of an individual's consciousness is transparent and inevitably revealed within a spiritual collective.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 9 GOD SHOWETH WHO IS AND WHO IS NOT PREPARED TO ENTER JEHOVIH’S KINGDOM ON EARTH.
attributions.surface_quote: Soon or late thine inmost thoughts will become known.

canonical_statement: The transformation of consciousness, specifically the removal of negative mental patterns, is a gradual process rather than an instantaneous event.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 9 GOD SHOWETH WHO IS AND WHO IS NOT PREPARED TO ENTER JEHOVIH’S KINGDOM ON EARTH.
attributions.surface_quote: To put away flesh-food is easy, but to put away dark thoughts... who can do this in a day?

canonical_statement: Individual isolation is incompatible with the structure of the divine kingdom.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 9 GOD SHOWETH WHO IS AND WHO IS NOT PREPARED TO ENTER JEHOVIH’S KINGDOM ON EARTH.
attributions.surface_quote: I renounce isolated labor.

canonical_statement: Restitution for moral transgression is achieved through direct acknowledgment to the aggrieved party or community, effectively nullifying the past wrong.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 10 GOD REVEALETH THE CURE FOR REMORSE.
attributions.surface_quote: acknowledge it to that member, and this shall be restitution

canonical_statement: Individuals associated in mortality maintain proximity in the afterlife, where past deeds become transparent to others.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 10 GOD REVEALETH THE CURE FOR REMORSE.
attributions.surface_quote: the same shall not be far distant on many occasions in the next world

canonical_statement: Self-pollution or dissipation constitutes a direct transgression against the Creator, requiring private confession and a covenant of cessation.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 10 GOD REVEALETH THE CURE FOR REMORSE.
attributions.surface_quote: if a man wrong himself... this is sin against Jehovih

canonical_statement: The purification of the spirit through humility and confession is a prerequisite for the attainment of spiritual power.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 10 GOD REVEALETH THE CURE FOR REMORSE.
attributions.surface_quote: this is Godliness... the beginning of power

canonical_statement: Entry into higher states of existence requires the total renunciation of attachments to lower planes of reality.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 GOD SHOWETH THAT THE RENUNCIATION OF THE UZIANS IS NECESSARY.
attributions.surface_quote: Whoso cannot in heart, and mind, and soul renounce all that is below is not prepared.

canonical_statement: Spiritual progress is contingent upon the alignment of individual consciousness with a higher collective or divine order.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 GOD SHOWETH THAT THE RENUNCIATION OF THE UZIANS IS NECESSARY.
attributions.surface_quote: Save the mind and heart be one with my holy place, the love of improvement will depart.

canonical_statement: Higher spiritual states are characterized by the transition from individual isolation to collective unity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 GOD SHOWETH THAT THE RENUNCIATION OF THE UZIANS IS NECESSARY.
attributions.surface_quote: Isolation belongeth below the second resurrection, but unity is within it.

canonical_statement: Individual autonomy is a limitation that is superseded by collective governance in higher states of being.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 GOD SHOWETH THAT THE RENUNCIATION OF THE UZIANS IS NECESSARY.
attributions.surface_quote: In the second resurrection the angels are relieved of individual responsibility.

canonical_statement: Societal structures evolve through a teleological progression from monarchy to republic to fraternity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 GOD SHOWETH THAT THE RENUNCIATION OF THE UZIANS IS NECESSARY.
attributions.surface_quote: First on earth, monarchies, then republics, then fraternities.

canonical_statement: The ideal social structure is defined by the dissolution of individual ego and the unification of purpose among members.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 GOD SHOWETH THAT THE RENUNCIATION OF THE UZIANS IS NECESSARY.
attributions.surface_quote: the members of the fraternity... can become one with one another

canonical_statement: Leadership functions as a collaborative service rather than an exercise of individual volition or authority.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 GOD SHOWETH THAT THE RENUNCIATION OF THE UZIANS IS NECESSARY.
attributions.surface_quote: not as rulers, but teachers

canonical_statement: The individual remains an integral part of the collective whole, precluding the formation of a separate, autonomous entity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 11 GOD SHOWETH THAT THE RENUNCIATION OF THE UZIANS IS NECESSARY.
attributions.surface_quote: he shall not... make himself a separate entity from the rest

canonical_statement: The highest mortal attribute is the capacity to extend love impartially to all beings.

attributions.surface_quote: This is the highest of all mortal attributes--to be impartial in love.

canonical_statement: Spiritual evolution involves the expansion of love beyond familial bonds to include all humanity.

attributions.surface_quote: Not to abridge love but to extend it, God-like, embracing all people.

canonical_statement: All phenomena originate from the Divine, either directly or indirectly.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 13 OF DESTROYERS AND OF BUILDERS.
attributions.surface_quote: all things are of Jehovih, either directly or indirectly

canonical_statement: Self-judgment aligned with the perspective of the Creator initiates spiritual progression.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 13 OF DESTROYERS AND OF BUILDERS.
attributions.surface_quote: In the day thou judgest thyself, as with the eye of thy Creator

canonical_statement: The transition from mortality to the eternal involves a shift in orientation toward the Divine.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 13 OF DESTROYERS AND OF BUILDERS.
attributions.surface_quote: turned from mortality toward Jehovih

canonical_statement: The second resurrection is initiated through the collective practice of righteousness within a fraternity.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 13 OF DESTROYERS AND OF BUILDERS.
attributions.surface_quote: joined with others in a fraternity to do these things--then thou hast begun the second resurrection

canonical_statement: Godliness is defined by the consistent application of moral judgment and practice within a social framework.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 13 OF DESTROYERS AND OF BUILDERS.
attributions.surface_quote: To be capable of judging the right, and ever to practice it within a fraternity--this is Godliness

canonical_statement: Individual autonomy in thought and speech is a fundamental principle of existence.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 14 GOD DISCOURSETH ON THE AUTHORITY OF HIS OWN WORDS.
attributions.surface_quote: freedom unto all people on earth... to think and to speak whatever they will.

canonical_statement: Knowledge is an experiential process that cannot be transferred between individuals.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 14 GOD DISCOURSETH ON THE AUTHORITY OF HIS OWN WORDS.
attributions.surface_quote: no man can acquire knowledge for another

canonical_statement: The perception of the Divine is subjective and correlates with individual happiness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 14 GOD DISCOURSETH ON THE AUTHORITY OF HIS OWN WORDS.
attributions.surface_quote: one man seeth Jehovih... he is happy. Another seeth not... He is not happy.

canonical_statement: The capacity to perceive harmony in creation is a variable individual faculty.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 14 GOD DISCOURSETH ON THE AUTHORITY OF HIS OWN WORDS.
attributions.surface_quote: One man distinguiseth the harmony of sounds... Another man cannot

canonical_statement: Alignment with divine action and ethical conduct facilitates a state of unity with the Creator.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 14 GOD DISCOURSETH ON THE AUTHORITY OF HIS OWN WORDS.
attributions.surface_quote: whoever do these are one with me in the framing of words.

canonical_statement: Unity with the Creator constitutes the state of Godliness.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 14 GOD DISCOURSETH ON THE AUTHORITY OF HIS OWN WORDS.
attributions.surface_quote: To be one with Jehovih, this is Godliness

canonical_statement: Truth possesses an inherent quality of permanence, whereas falsehood is transient.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 14 GOD DISCOURSETH ON THE AUTHORITY OF HIS OWN WORDS.
attributions.surface_quote: Truth expounded shall never die; the discrepancy from truth is short-lived.

canonical_statement: The alignment of individual intent with the Creator is the necessary condition for spiritual resurrection.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 14 GOD DISCOURSETH ON THE AUTHORITY OF HIS OWN WORDS.
attributions.surface_quote: On the foundation of an All Person... lie the beginning and the way of everlasting resurrection.

canonical_statement: Individual sincerity and self-discipline function as conduits for the manifestation of spiritual power.

attributions.chapter: Chapter 14 GOD DISCOURSETH ON THE AUTHORITY OF HIS OWN WORDS.
attributions.surface_quote: when thou hast attained this, thy words shall be with power.
